newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chiwan Wharf 96 net hits 107 m.
newsitem.headline: Chiwan Wharf 96 net hits 107 m.

text.p: Chiwan Wharf Holdings Ltd booked net profits of 107.30 million yuan on turnover of 409.86 million in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a statement after the market closed on Monday.
Earnings per share were 0.281 yuan, with net assets per share at 2.52 yuan at end-1996, the statement said.
It did not say whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards.
Company officials were not available for comment.
According to Chiwan's 1995 annual report, the company had net profits of 124.36 million yuan for 1995 based on international accounting standards.
The company's 1995 turnover was 435.36 million yuan on domestic standards.
Chiwan's board of directors proposed a cash dividend of 0.169 yuan per share based on the 1996 net, the statement said.
Trading in Chiwan's A and B shares will be suspended on Tuesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, it said.
